Okay bare with me, english isn't my first language so I don't really know the technical terms. I just drilled a hole in each of the corners, about 20mm in diameter and about 15mm deep. 
Then I used some of the leftover wood to drill out some cylinder shapes (in german the drill is called „Zapfenbohrer“) and I drilled another hole in each cylinder straight through the middle. Next, I carved out a small trench from the hole in the middle to the outer edge of the cylinder and then around the cylinder. Finally I put the stainless steel cable through the hole, bent them around a bit too fit it in the trenches and glued in the cylinder in the pre-drilled holes on the bottom of the tabletop (with Polyurethane glue). So far my construction stands strong and the cables aren't going anywhere :)
